info.name: Scholarship Portal API
info.description:
Walks the scholarship workflow: programmes, applying, eligibility score, one application per scholarship, decisions with reasons, statistics and security.
Start the backend first (http://localhost:8105). Repeatable: it registers a fresh student, creates uniquely named scholarships and hides them at the end.

exec: const iso = (offset) => { const t = new Date(); t.setDate(t.getDate() + offset); return `${t.getFullYear()}-${String(t.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}-${String(t.getDate()).padStart(2, '0')}`; };

item.name: Register a fresh student for this run

body.raw:
{
  "name": "Postman Grant A {{runId}}",
  "description": "Created by the Postman run",
  "amount": 25000,
  "deadline": "{{future}}",
  "minGpa": 7.0,
  "maxFamilyIncome": 800000
}

exec: pm.test("Open and active", () => { const p = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(p.open).to.be.true; pm.expect(p.active).to.be.true; });

exec: pm.test("A and B are open, C is listed but closed", () => {
pm.test("Submitted, score 84, meets criteria", () => { pm.expect(a.status).to.eql("SUBMITTED"); pm.expect(a.eligibilityScore).to.eql(84); pm.expect(a.meetsCriteria).to.be.true; });

item.name: Apply to B (does not meet the criteria, still allowed)

exec: pm.test("Score 54, does not meet criteria", () => { pm.expect(a.eligibilityScore).to.eql(54); pm.expect(a.meetsCriteria).to.be.false; });

item.name: Applying to A again is a conflict
Mandatory fields are reported per field
Another student does not see them

exec: pm.test("Approved, recorded, with reason", () => { const a = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(a.status).to.eql("APPROVED"); pm.expect(a.decidedBy).to.eql("scholarship"); pm.expect(a.decisionReason).to.eql("Strong record"); });
